description.ru: Развивайте практический английский уровня B1 для работы по теме «Приоритеты, продуктивность и рабочая нагрузка».
description.en: Develop practical B1 workplace English for priorities, productivity and workload.

objective.ru: Использовать английский уровня B1 для объяснения рабочих ситуаций, обсуждения вариантов и согласования следующих действий.
objective.en: Use B1 English to explain workplace situations, discuss options, and agree on next actions.

instructions.en: Match the English words with their translations.

data.question: Which response communicates the workplace situation most effectively?

options.text: When my workload exceeds my capacity, I identify the most urgent priority and delegate suitable tasks.
The problem does not need an explanation or any further action.
No one should receive information about the decision.

data.explanation: The correct response gives clear B1-level information and connects the situation to an action or reason.
